ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, within rectangle $ABCD$, points $E$ and $F$ are the midpoints of sides $AB$ and $BC$ respectively. Lines $EC$ and $FD$ are connected, and points $H$ and $G$ are the midpoints of $EC$ and $FD$ respectively. Line $GH$ is connected. If $AB = 6$ and $BC = 8$, then what is the length of $GH$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Join CH and extend it to intersect AD at P, connect PE,

$\because$ Quadrilateral ABCD is a rectangle,

$\therefore \angle A=90^\circ$, AD$\parallel$BC,

$\because$ E and F are the midpoints of AB and BC, respectively, AB$=6$, BC$=8$,

$\therefore$ AE$=\frac{1}{2}$AB$=3$, CF$=\frac{1}{2}$BC$=4$,

$\because$ AD$\parallel$BC,

$\therefore \angle DPH=\angle FCH$,

In $\triangle PDH$ and $\triangle CFH$, $\left\{\begin{array}{l}\angle DPH=\angle FCH \\ \angle DHP=\angle FHC \\ DH=FH \end{array}\right.$,

$\therefore \triangle PDH \cong \triangle CFH$ (AAS),

$\therefore$ PD$=$CF$=4$, CH$=$PH,

$\therefore$ AP$=$AD$-$PD$=4$,

$\therefore$ PE$=\sqrt{AP^{2}+AE^{2}}=\sqrt{4^{2}+3^{2}}=5$,

$\because$ Point G is the midpoint of EC,

$\therefore$ GH$=\frac{1}{2}$EP$=\boxed{\frac{5}{2}}$.

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is rectangle ABCD, A is at the upper left, B is at the lower left, D is at the upper right, C is at the lower right; E is marked at the midpoint of the left side AB, and F is marked at the midpoint of the lower side BC. In the figure, EC and FD are connected, and marked as shown in the figure, G is on EC, H is on FD, and line segment GH is also connected. Reasoning: According to the construction of the auxiliary line, draw a straight line through C and H and extend it, intersecting AD at P, then connect PE. Because ABCD is a rectangle, AD ∥ BC, and ∠A=90°. It is known that AB=6, BC=8, and E and F are respectively the midpoints of AB and BC, so AE=3, CF=4, and AD=BC=8. Since AD ∥ BC, and P, H, C are collinear, obtain ∠DPH=∠FCH; also because D, H, F are collinear and P, H, C are collinear, ∠DHP=∠FHC. H is the midpoint of FD, so DH=FH. Therefore △PDH and △CFH are congruent, obtaining PD=CF=4, PH=CH. Thus AP=AD−PD=8−4=4. △APE is a right triangle, PE=sqrt(AP^2+AE^2)=sqrt(4^2+3^2)=5. Also in △CPE, G is the midpoint of CE, H is the midpoint of CP, so GH is the midline of triangle CPE, GH=PE/2=5/2.
